text_blocks.snippet: Children may experience similar symptoms to adults with COVID-19, but they may also have unique presentations. Common symptoms in children include:
Fever, Cough, Runny nose, Sore throat, Fatigue, and Headache.
snippet_highlighted_words: Fever, Cough, Runny nose, Sore throat, Fatigue, and Headache

text_blocks.snippet: More severe symptoms: Difficulty breathing, Chest pain, Bluish lips or nails, Persistent vomiting or diarrhea, and Seizures (rare).
Unique symptoms in children: diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, irritability, and loss of appetite.

It's important to note that some children may be asymptomatic or have very mild symptoms. If your child has any symptoms that may indicate COVID-19, it's essential to consult a healthcare professional for evaluation and testing.
